abilities.name: Read the Current
abilities.text: After you manoeuvre, you may move one opposing fighter 1 space.

ability.immediately: Move the opposing fighter up to 2 spaces. {{custom:symbol_baseline_spark}}
ability.afterCombat: If you won the combat, draw 1 card.

ability.duringCombat: Add 1 to this card’s value for each adjacent fighter.

defenseAbility.afterCombat: You may place Mariner in any adjacent space.

ability.plain: Choose a Lantern Guard. Move it up to 3 spaces.

ability.afterCombat: If the Lantern Guard is adjacent to another Guard, recover 1 health.

cards.subject: villain
cards.rightNow: Move toward the nearest hero, then attack.

cards.subject: minion
cards.rightNow: Place one defeated Lantern Guard adjacent to the Regent.
cards.endOfRound: Each hero adjacent to a Guard takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Setup
cards.heading: Setup
cards.body:
Place the Regent on space A. Each hero starts on a numbered space.

Keep the tide marker nearby.

cards.name: Tide Reference
cards.heading: Tide Reference
cards.body:
Low tide: blue paths are open.

High tide: advance threat.

cards.name: Sudden Squall
cards.heading: Sudden Squall
cards.body: Move every fighter on a blue space to the nearest connected space.

threat.subtitle: The Shattered Causeway
threat.rules: Advance after resolving a Villain Effect card.
